We live in the neighborhoods we serve, working for a better tomorrow. We're nearly 10,000 people committed to providing safe, reliable and sustainable electric, gas and water service in Massachusetts, Connecticut and New Hampshire.Our operations trace their roots back to the middle of the 19th century. Through the decades, many companies have come together to form Eversource, New England’s largest energy delivery company.Today, we’re proud to serve 4.4 million customers. Like our predecessor companies, we’re focused on supporting every one of our communities, to power the possible for New England.
